preexecution.scope: One frozen compound intent, two languages, four model arms, complete and deliberately inconsistent contracts. These views and repeats are not distinct ideas. Baseline makes eight fresh native requests; continuation makes one. This compares client policies, not equal-call kernel throughput. Models rank once before tests, without feedback reranking or new training.

scope: Declared seven cases, no new heldout set or training. Raw 288 native captures are separate. CPU is child CPU time, not host utilization delta; RSS is child lifetime high-water, not additive restart memory or model memory. Progress bitset excludes model, arena, frontier, runtime and retained receipts.
